title: 07. Concurrency: Producer-Consumer Pattern
summary: The Producer-Consumer pattern decouples data generation from data processing using a queue as a buffer. Producers create work items; consumers process them.

sections.title: Explanation
sections.body:
The **Producer-Consumer** pattern decouples data generation from data processing using a queue as a buffer. Producers create work items; consumers process them. The queue handles backpressure automatically.

```
[Producer 1] ──┐
[Producer 2] ──┼──→ [Queue (buffer)] ──→ [Consumer 1]
[Producer 3] ──┘                    └──→ [Consumer 2]
                                    └──→ [Consumer 3]
```

sections.title: Full Production Example
sections.body:
```python
import asyncio
import aiohttp
import aiofiles
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional

@dataclass
class ScrapedPage:
    url: str
    content: Optional[str] = None
    status: Optional[int] = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    elapsed_ms: float = 0

async def url_producer(
    urls: list,
    work_queue: asyncio.Queue,
    num_consumers: int
):
    """Puts URLs into queue for consumers"""
    for url in urls:
        await work_queue.put(url)
        print(f"  📥 Queued: {url} (queue size: {work_queue.qsize()})")

    # Send sentinel values to stop consumers
    for _ in range(num_consumers):
        await work_queue.put(None)  # One sentinel per consumer

    print(f"Producer done — sent {len(urls)} URLs")

async def page_fetcher(
    worker_id: int,
    work_queue: asyncio.Queue,
    result_queue: asyncio.Queue,
    session: aiohttp.ClientSession
):
    """Consumer — fetches pages from work queue"""
    print(f"  Worker {worker_id}: started")
    fetched = 0

    while True:
        url = await work_queue.get()

        if url is None:  # Sentinel — stop
            work_queue.task_done()
            print(f"  Worker {worker_id}: stopping (fetched {fetched})")
            break

        start = time.monotonic()
        try:
            async with session.get(url, timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=10)) as resp:
                content = await resp.text()
                elapsed = (time.monotonic() - start) * 1000
                page = ScrapedPage(
                    url=url,
                    content=content[:200],  # First 200 chars
                    status=resp.status,
                    elapsed_ms=elapsed
                )
        except Exception as e:
            elapsed = (time.monotonic() - start) * 1000
            page = ScrapedPage(url=url, error=str(e), elapsed_ms=elapsed)

        await result_queue.put(page)
        work_queue.task_done()
        fetched += 1

async def result_saver(
    result_queue: asyncio.Queue,
    output_file: str,
    total_expected: int
):
    """Consumer — saves results to file"""
    saved = 0
    errors = 0

    async with aiofiles.open(output_file, "w") as f:
        await f.write("url,status,elapsed_ms,error\n")  # CSV header

        while saved + errors < total_expected:
            page = await result_queue.get()

            if page.error:
                errors += 1
                await f.write(f"{page.url},,{page.elapsed_ms:.0f},{page.error}\n")
            else:
                saved += 1
                await f.write(f"{page.url},{page.status},{page.elapsed_ms:.0f},\n")

            await f.flush()  # Ensure it's written

    print(f"\n📊 Results: {saved} saved, {errors} errors")
    return saved, errors

async def run_scraper(urls: list, num_workers: int = 5, output: str = "results.csv"):
    work_queue   = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=num_workers * 2)  # Bounded — backpressure
    result_queue = asyncio.Queue()

    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        # Start all components concurrently
        await asyncio.gather(
            url_producer(urls, work_queue, num_workers),
            *[page_fetcher(i, work_queue, result_queue, session)
              for i in range(num_workers)],
            result_saver(result_queue, output, len(urls)),
        )

async def main():
    urls = [f"https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/{i}" for i in range(1, 21)]

    start = time.time()
    await run_scraper(urls, num_workers=5, output="/tmp/results.csv")
    print(f"Total time: {time.time()-start:.2f}s")

asyncio.run(main())
```
